name: Black River Bottoms Access
description: Primitive access in the Black River Bottoms, Corps of Engineers land at the upper end of Clearwater Lake.
road_access: Reynolds County Road 464 through the Black River Bottoms. Dirt and sand roads; high clearance recommended.
